extract_h36m_validation_data: extract Human3.6M validation dataset frames and 3D poses for users 9 and 11 into an NPZ file
extract_h36m_with_images: extract Human3.6M validation data and save video frames as JPEG images alongside pose annotations
extract_h36m_without_images: extract Human3.6M validation pose data without extracting video frames to save disk space
convert_h36m_joints_to_global: convert Human3.6M 17-joint 3D pose coordinates to a 24-joint global skeleton format
compute_bbox_from_2d_pose: compute bounding box coordinates from 2D pose keypoints using min and max point values
